one_line: Late 14th–early 15th century sultan of Kashmir, remembered both for mosque-building and harsh policies toward temples and non-Muslim elites.

appearance.age_look: Early 40s, medium height with a lean but authoritative build and straight posture.
appearance.face: Oval face, wheatish Kashmiri complexion, sharp aquiline nose, neatly trimmed black beard with a few silver strands at the chin, focused narrow brown eyes, slightly furrowed brows, default expression calm and calculating with a restrained, regal seriousness.
appearance.hair: Straight black hair, medium length, mostly hidden under a tall conical Kashmiri Sultanate turban wrapped in deep green fabric with a cream under-cap and a thin gold band at the base, only short side locks visible before the ears.
appearance.costume: He wears a long Kashmiri Sultanate jama (robe) of rich matte maroon wool, fitted at the torso and flaring below the waist, with full sleeves and a front opening fastened by small toggles; the collar, sleeve cuffs, and front edges are edged with narrow gold thread embroidery in simple geometric motifs. Over this, a sleeveless dark forest-green woollen over-robe falls to mid-calf, open in front, with subtle tone-on-tone woven patterns hinting at status. A wide cream-colored cloth belt with a faint diagonal stripe pattern wraps his waist twice and knots slightly to the left, the ends hanging neatly. He wears loose cream churidar-style trousers tucked into soft mid-calf brown leather boots without laces, the tops gently folded. Around his neck is a simple gold chain and a small oval seal-pendant; his wrists bear two plain gold bangles. The fabrics look warm and practical for Kashmir’s climate, with subdued but rich colors befitting a sultan rather than ostentatious finery.
appearance.signature: A slightly curved Indo-Persian style sword (talwar) at his left hip in a plain brown leather scabbard with modest brass fittings, its hilt visible above the belt with a disc-shaped pommel and simple cross-guard, often held lightly at the scabbard as he stands.

ref_desc: Sikandar Shah is a wheat-complexioned Kashmiri sultan with an oval face, short black hair under a tall green turban, maroon jama, forest-green over-robe, cream belt and trousers, brown boots, gold accents, and a curved talwar at his left hip.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style character model of Sikandar Shah as a Kashmiri sultan: a wheat-complexioned man in his early forties with an oval face, aquiline nose, narrow brown eyes and a neatly trimmed black beard touched with a little silver at the chin. His short straight black hair is mostly hidden by a tall conical deep green Kashmiri Sultanate turban, with a cream under-cap and a thin gold band at the base, only small side locks visible near his ears. He wears a long maroon wool jama robe fitted to the torso and flaring below the waist, full sleeves, and a front opening fastened with small toggles; the collar, sleeve cuffs and front edges are trimmed with narrow gold embroidered geometric motifs. Over this sits a sleeveless dark forest-green wool over-robe to mid-calf, open at the front with subtle tone-on-tone woven patterns. A wide cream cloth belt with a faint diagonal stripe pattern wraps his waist twice and knots slightly left, ends hanging neatly, over loose cream churidar-style trousers tucked into soft mid-calf brown leather boots with simple folded tops. Show a plain gold chain with a small oval seal pendant at his neck and two simple gold bangles at his wrists. At his left hip, attached to the belt, is his signature slightly curved Indo-Persian sword in a plain brown leather scabbard with modest brass fittings, the disc-pommel hilt visible and one hand often resting lightly on the scabbard. Use maroon, forest green, cream, brown and gold as the dominant colors, and present him standing upright, calmly authoritative, in a neutral pose that clearly displays his face, turban, layered garments, boots and sword from head to toe.
